Linear.desc: Affine projection y = x · Wᵀ + b.

ConvBlock.desc: Conv → Norm → Activation, the canonical CNN unit.
ConvBlock.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

DepthwiseSeparableConv2d.desc: Depthwise spatial conv followed by 1×1 pointwise conv (MobileNet).
DepthwiseSeparableConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

DilatedConv2d.desc: Standard conv with dilation > 1 (atrous), enlarges receptive field for free.
DilatedConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

GroupConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

Conv3d.shapes: (B, C, T, H, W) → (B, C', T, H, W)

AdaIN.desc: Adaptive Instance Normalisation: replace x's per-channel stats with style stats.
AdaIN.shapes: x:(B, C, H, W), s:(B, C) → y:(B, C, H, W)

SPADE.desc: Spatially-adaptive denormalisation: γ, β come from a segmentation map.
SPADE.shapes: x:(B, C, H, W), seg:(B, K, H, W) → y:(B, C, H, W)

ResidualBlock.desc: Two conv-norm-act stack with identity skip and post-add activation.
ResidualBlock.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C, H, W)

SkipConnection.desc: Generic identity skip around any sub-module f.

MultiHeadAttention.desc: Standard scaled dot-product attention with H heads and an output projection.

SelfAttention.desc: MultiHeadAttention applied with Q = K = V = x.

rows.label: derive Q, K, V from x

CausalSelfAttention.desc: SelfAttention with an upper-triangular mask preventing future leakage.

CrossAttention.desc: Q comes from x, K and V come from a separate context tensor.
CrossAttention.shapes: x:(B, T_q, D), ctx:(B, T_k, D) → (B, T_q, D)

WindowAttention.desc: Self-attention restricted to non-overlapping w×w windows (Swin).
WindowAttention.shapes: (B, H, W, C) → (B, H, W, C)

LinearAttention.desc: Kernelised attention with O(N) cost via Q · (Kᵀ V).

FlashAttention.desc: Mathematically identical to MHA, but uses tiled IO-aware kernels.

rows.label: flash kernel  (tiled softmax, no materialised attn matrix)

RotaryEmbedding.desc: Inject absolute position into Q, K via per-pair rotations.
RotaryEmbedding.shapes: Q,K:(B, H, T, d) → rotated Q,K

RelativePositionBias.desc: Learnable bias added to attention logits as a function of (i − j).

AttentionPooling.desc: A learnable query attends over a sequence to produce a single pooled vector.

transformer.desc: Transformer encoder / decoder, FFN variants, MoE.

FeedForward.desc: Two-layer MLP with an inner hidden dim r × D.

SwiGLU.desc: Gated FFN where the gate path uses SiLU (LLaMA-style).

GEGLU.desc: Same gated FFN as SwiGLU but with GELU on the gate.

TransformerEncoderBlock.desc: Pre-norm transformer block: LN → MHA → +; LN → FFN → +.

TransformerDecoderBlock.desc: Pre-norm decoder: causal self-attn, cross-attn over context, FFN.
TransformerDecoderBlock.shapes: x:(B, T, D), ctx:(B, M, D) → (B, T, D)

MixtureOfExperts.desc: Top-k gated mixture: router scores experts, top-k run, weighted sum.

SwitchMoE.desc: MoE specialisation with k = 1: a single expert per token.

InceptionBlock.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

DenseBlock.desc: Each layer's input is the concatenation of all earlier layers' outputs (DenseNet).
DenseBlock.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C + k·L, H, W)

SqueezeExcitation.desc: Channel-wise gating via global pool → bottleneck MLP → sigmoid.
SqueezeExcitation.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C, H, W)

CBAM.desc: Sequential channel attention then spatial attention.
CBAM.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C, H, W)

rows.label: Spatial Attention  (Conv on max+avg over C)

FeaturePyramidNetwork.desc: Build multi-scale feature maps via top-down upsampling + lateral 1×1 connections.

rows.label: C3, C4, C5  (B, Cᵢ, H/2ⁱ, W/2ⁱ)

ASPP.desc: Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling: parallel atrous convs + image pool, concatenated.
ASPP.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

PixelShuffleUpsample.desc: Sub-pixel upsampling: rearrange r² channels into r×r spatial blocks.
PixelShuffleUpsample.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C, r·H, r·W)

DeformableConv2d.desc: Conv whose sample locations are shifted by a learned offset field.
DeformableConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

DeformableAttention.desc: Attention that samples a small set of keys at learned offsets per query (Deformable DETR).

unet_diffusion.desc: UNet, time conditioning, ControlNet, LoRA, hypernets.

SinusoidalTimeEmbedding.desc: Sin/cos positional embedding of the diffusion timestep t.

TimestepMLP.desc: Two-layer MLP applied to the time embedding before injection.

DownsampleBlock.desc: Spatial downsample by 2× via a strided 3×3 conv.

UpsampleBlock.desc: Nearest-neighbour upsample by 2× followed by a 3×3 conv.

UNetResBlock.desc: Residual block conditioned on a time embedding (added between the two convs).
UNetResBlock.shapes: x:(B, C, H, W), t:(B, D) → (B, C', H, W)

UNet.desc: Encoder-decoder with skip connections at matching resolutions; bottleneck attention.
UNet.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C, H, W)

rows.label: y  noise pred  (B, C, H, W)

NoisePredictor.desc: End-to-end ε-prediction network used by DDPM/DDIM samplers.

ZeroConv2d.desc: Conv2d initialised to zero — outputs zero at start so it can be added safely.
ZeroConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

rows.label: y  (B, C', H, W)  (= 0 at init)

ControlNetBlock.desc: Trainable copy of UNet encoder + ZeroConvs; outputs are added to the frozen UNet decoder.

LoRALinear.desc: Frozen linear plus a low-rank residual B·A·x scaled by α/r.

LoRAConv2d.desc: Same low-rank residual idea applied to 2-D convolutions.
LoRAConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

HyperNetwork.desc: A meta-network that emits weights consumed by a target network.

rows.label: target net  (uses θ on input x)

IPAdapterCrossAttention.desc: Two parallel cross-attentions (text and image) summed into the residual stream.
IPAdapterCrossAttention.shapes: x:(B, T, D), text/image features → (B, T, D)

gan.desc: GAN building blocks: StyleGAN, PGGAN, equalised LR.

EqualLinear.desc: Linear with equalized learning rate: weight scaled at runtime by gain/√fan_in.

EqualConv2d.desc: Conv2d with equalized learning rate (StyleGAN family).
EqualConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

GeneratorBlock.desc: Vanilla generator block: upsample → conv → norm → activation.

DiscriminatorBlock.desc: Vanilla discriminator block: strided conv → norm → leaky ReLU.

MappingNetwork.desc: 8-layer MLP with reduced LR that maps z → w (StyleGAN).

StyleBlock.desc: Conv + per-pixel noise + AdaIN modulated by style w (StyleGAN v1).
StyleBlock.shapes: x:(B, C, H, W), w:(B, D) → y

ModulatedConv2d.desc: StyleGAN2 modulated conv: scale weights by style, demodulate, then convolve.
ModulatedConv2d.shapes: x:(B, C, H, W), w:(B, D) → y

MinibatchStdDev.desc: Append a per-batch standard-deviation map as an extra channel (PGGAN/StyleGAN).

rows.label: std over batch  (per channel, per pixel)

ProgressiveGrowing.desc: Fade in a new high-res block via α-blend with the previous resolution (PGGAN).

PatchEmbedding.desc: Strided p×p conv that turns an image into a sequence of patch tokens.

CLSToken.desc: Prepend a learnable [CLS] token to each sequence (used as the global representation).

SwinWindowAttention.desc: Self-attention restricted to non-overlapping w×w windows with relative-pos bias.
SwinWindowAttention.shapes: (B, N, C) → (B, N, C)  with implicit (H, W)

ShiftedWindowAttention.desc: Cyclic-shift variant that lets adjacent windows exchange information.
ShiftedWindowAttention.shapes: (B, N, C) → (B, N, C)  with implicit (H, W)

MaskedImageModeling.desc: MAE/BEiT objective: random-mask patches, encode visible tokens, reconstruct.
MaskedImageModeling.shapes: (B, N, D) → masked, (B, N, p²·C) reconstructed

RNNCell.desc: Vanilla recurrent cell: h_t = tanh(W_x x_t + W_h h_{t-1} + b).

LSTMCell.desc: Long short-term memory cell with input/forget/cell/output gates.

GRUCell.desc: Gated recurrent unit: reset (r), update (z) and candidate (n) gates.

StateSpaceModel.desc: Linear SSM with discretized A, B and an output mapping y = C h + D u.
StateSpaceModel.shapes: u:(B, T, D) → y:(B, T, D)

rows.label: scan  h_t = Ā h_{t−1} + B̄ u_t

MambaBlock.desc: Selective state-space block: gates, conv, input-dependent SSM, gated output.

rows.label: selective SSM  (A, Δ, B, C from x)

MessagePassing.desc: Generic message-passing skeleton: message → aggregate → update.
MessagePassing.shapes: X:(N, F), edges:(2, E) → X':(N, F')

GraphConv.desc: GCN propagation: H' = Â · X · W with symmetric normalisation.

GraphAttention.desc: GAT: per-edge attention coefficients followed by neighbour aggregation.

generative.desc: VAE, autoregressive, normalising-flow, EBM, diffusion schedulers.

VAE.desc: Encoder → posterior (μ, σ) → reparameterised z → decoder.
VAE.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C, H, W)

rows.label: z = μ + ε ⊙ σ,   ε ∼ N(0, I)

MaskedConv2d.desc: Conv2d with an autoregressive mask preventing each pixel from seeing future pixels (PixelCNN).
MaskedConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

AutoregressiveBlock.desc: Stack of masked convs producing a per-pixel distribution over the next pixel.
AutoregressiveBlock.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, K, H, W)  logits

AffineCouplingLayer.desc: Normalising-flow coupling: split, predict scale/shift from one half, transform the other.
AffineCouplingLayer.shapes: x = (a, b) → y = (a, b · exp(s) + t)

rows.label: a' = a,  b' = b ⊙ exp(s) + t

EnergyBasedModel.desc: A network that maps x to a scalar energy E(x); samples drawn via Langevin/MCMC.

DDPMScheduler.desc: Forward diffusion: x_t = √α̅_t · x_0 + √(1 − α̅_t) · ε.

DDIMScheduler.desc: Deterministic non-Markovian sampler that reuses the predicted x̂_0.

PolicyNetwork.desc: Maps a state to an action distribution / Gaussian (μ, σ) / discrete logits.

QNetwork.desc: Estimates Q(s, a) — either by concatenating (s, a) or with one head per discrete action.

ActorCritic.desc: Shared trunk that branches into a policy head and a value head.

ReplayBuffer.desc: Ring buffer storing transitions; sampled in mini-batches for off-policy learning.

TargetNetwork.desc: Slowly-tracking copy of the online network used to stabilise bootstrap targets.

memory_retrieval.desc: External memory, vector stores, RAG, KV caches.

ExternalMemory.desc: Soft attention over an external memory bank acts as a read operation.
ExternalMemory.shapes: q:(B, D), mem:(M, D) → r:(B, D)

VectorStore.desc: Encode a corpus into a vector index, then look up the top-k nearest neighbours.

RAGModule.desc: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: retrieve top-k docs, condition the LM on them.

KVCache.desc: Cache K, V tensors per layer per token to skip re-encoding history.

rows.label: cached K, V  (L, B, T, D)

embedding.desc: Token / positional / projection embeddings, contrastive losses.

LearnedPositionalEmbedding.desc: A separate learned vector per absolute position, added to the token embedding.

SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding.desc: Fixed sin/cos position encoding (Vaswani et al.).

ProjectionHead.desc: Two-layer MLP + L2 normalisation, used for contrastive / representation learning.

CLIPLoss.desc: Symmetric InfoNCE between matched image / text embeddings.

info_nce.desc: Pairwise InfoNCE used by SimCLR / MoCo.

EMA.desc: Exponential moving average of model weights.

MixedPrecisionTrainer.desc: Loss-scaled fp16 forward, fp32 master weights, gradient unscale + clip + step.

CheckpointedSequential.desc: Sequential whose forward is rematerialised on the backward pass to save memory.

CLIPEncoder.desc: Dual-tower image / text encoders with projection heads into a shared space.

PerceiverResampler.desc: Fixed-length learnable latents cross-attend over arbitrary-length media features.
PerceiverResampler.shapes: media:(B, M, D), latents:(L, D) → (B, L, D)

QFormer.desc: BLIP-2 querying transformer: queries self-attend, then cross-attend to image features.

ToolUseBlock.desc: Soft selector over a set of tools, each invoked, results merged back into the state.

MemoryAttention.desc: Cross-attention layer that reads from an external memory bank.
MemoryAttention.shapes: x:(B, T, D), mem:(M, D) → (B, T, D)

QuantizedLinearInt8.desc: Linear with weights stored in int8 + per-output-channel scale.

QuantizedLinear4bit.desc: Linear with weights packed to 4-bit + grouped scales / zeros (NF4 / GPTQ style).

MagnitudePruner.desc: Zero-out weights with |W| below a threshold τ.

TokenPruner.desc: Drop low-importance tokens before further attention layers.
TokenPruner.shapes: (B, N, D) → (B, K, D),  K < N

LowRankLinear.desc: Two stacked linears whose product approximates a full matrix W ≈ U Vᵀ.

ColumnParallelLinear.desc: Linear whose output columns are sharded across tensor-parallel ranks.

RowParallelLinear.desc: Linear whose input is sharded across ranks; outputs all-reduced.

PipelineStage.desc: One stage of pipeline parallelism — receives micro-batches, computes, sends forward.

specialized.desc: Specialised research blocks (NeuralODE, FNO, KAN, capsules, slots).

NeuralODE.desc: Treat depth as continuous time and integrate dx/dt = f_θ(x, t).

SpectralConv2d.desc: Multiply low-frequency Fourier modes by learned weights (Fourier Neural Operator).
SpectralConv2d.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C', H, W)

FNOBlock.desc: FNO block: spectral conv + 1×1 conv, summed and activated.
FNOBlock.shapes: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C, H, W)

KANLayer.desc: Kolmogorov–Arnold layer: every edge has a learned univariate spline; node = sum of edges.

rows.label: sum over inputs at each output node

CapsuleLayer.desc: Capsule routing layer (Sabour et al.): predict votes, dynamic routing-by-agreement, squash.

SlotAttention.desc: Iterated cross-attention from a small set of slots into per-pixel features (SlotAttention).
SlotAttention.shapes: feats:(B, N, D), slots:(B, K, D) → slots
